name: backlog-triage
description: Sort a new backlog entry into a group and a repository, or answer unknown. Repositories, groups and entries are synthetic. The keyword baseline was written against the dev split only.

group.instructions: Which backlog group does this entry belong to? Answer unknown if it does not clearly fit.

criteria.util: Improvements, bugs and features in the tools and services that run the portfolio
criteria.sec: Security: credentials, access, exposure and hardening
criteria.research: Investigation or evaluation before anything is built
criteria.health: Machine, drive or service health, monitoring and maintenance
criteria.unknown: Does not clearly belong to any listed group

repo.instructions: Which repository is this entry about? Answer unknown if it does not clearly belong to one.

criteria.scheduler-service: Schedules and runs recurring jobs; the job, timer and schedule pages
criteria.list-manager: Personal lists: groceries, shopping, to-do, watch, read, invest
criteria.media-library: Organizes, plays and upscales the local video library
criteria.torrent-ui: A web page to add and manage torrents and their limits
criteria.session-viewer: Reviews, resumes and deletes AI assistant sessions
criteria.receipt-reader: Scans, parses and reports on receipts and documents
criteria.local-llm: Runs local language models and benchmarks them
criteria.network-guard: VPN switching, private tunnels and network status
criteria.secret-vault: Password and credential retrieval for other tools
criteria.notifier: Sends messages and alerts to phones and email
criteria.resource-monitor: Machine, drive and repository resource dashboards
criteria.web-ingress: Reverse proxy, certificates and internal DNS for the sites
criteria.unknown: Does not clearly belong to any listed repository
